zone_rule: Cut points at c - s/2 and c + s/2, where c = (female mean + male mean) / 2 and s = pooled within-sex SD; one value per speaker from the single-pass measurement. The middle band is one pooled SD wide, centred where the two sex means are equally far away. Cohen's d = (female mean - male mean) / s; when |d| < 1 both sex means fall inside the middle band, i.e. the metric does not separate the sexes on this corpus. Non-gendered metrics use the same cut points, with c serving as a sex-balanced centre so the female majority does not pull it.

texts: There is , according to legend, a boiling pot of gold at one end.
People look, but no one ever finds it.
When a man looks for something beyond his reach, his friends say he is looking for the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.
Throughout the centuries people have explained the rainbow in various ways.
